why: Two death-payoff swaps the pilot called 2026-09-12: Elenda, the Dusk Rose for Gifted Aetherborn, Blade of the Bloodchief for Unbounded Potential. Both turn the nine sacrifice outlets into counters, and Elenda into lifelink tokens on death, doubled by Procession and Mondrak. Nothing dies in the goldfish and the Forge AI does not sacrifice in response, so the objective is a CONTROL at the champion's own kill-by-8 reading.
